corrected_row.notes: Coverage: §§ 552.221, 552.2615, 552.263, 552.301-.308, 1 TAC ch. 70, Handbook Part VII. No rule forfeits the fee for a late response. The nearest consequences are cost-notice failures: no itemized statement -> collection capped at $40 (1 TAC § 70.7(a), TX-9018); no updated statement -> capped at 120% of the original estimate (§ 552.2615(d), TX-9019). Late AG-ruling requests trigger a presumption of openness (§ 552.302), not fee forfeiture.

notes: Access caveats: (1) statutes.capitol.texas.gov now serves a JS SPA shell to non-browser fetchers; the identical codified document was verified on the Texas Legislative Council's own text service (tcss.legis.texas.gov/Docs/GV/htm/GV.552.htm, and CR.2B.htm for the body-cam delegation) — same publisher, same document path. (2) The SOS TAC Appian portal (texas-sos.appianportalsgov.com) is JS-rendered and could not be opened by fetch (its SAIL API rejects non-browser clients), so all 1 TAC ch. 70 quotes were verified verbatim against the Office of the Attorney General's official 2026 PIA Handbook (PIA-Handbook-2026.pdf, opened in full), which reproduces ch. 70 — confirming both text and currency into 2026. The specific TexReg source-note dates asserted in effective_status fields (e.g., 'eff. Feb. 22, 2007, 32 TexReg 614') could not be independently re-verified for that reason, but the operative text and figures were. Statute currency: amendment notes show no 2024-2026 session law touching the fee/estimate/deposit sections; 2023 H.B. 3033 amended 552.271/.272/.275 and 2025 H.B. 4219 amended 552.221 without altering any quoted subsection. Verdicts: 34 CONFIRMED, 2 CORRECTED (rules.minFee and waiver.forfeiture — provenance only: TAC quotes were pointed at the statute page; resolutions unchanged), 0 REFUTED, 0 UNVERIFIABLE.
